## English

- Change GPU utilization and VRAM bars to a 1.5-second ease-out transition: move quickly at first, then gradually slow down and settle at the latest reading without overshoot or rebound. Both rising and falling values use the same motion.
- Continue from the currently displayed width when a new sample arrives during a transition.

## 简体中文

- GPU 利用率和显存占用进度条改为 1.5 秒缓出动画：开始快速推进，接近最新读数时逐渐减速并平稳停住，不越界、不回弹；升高和降低均使用这一效果。
- 动画期间收到新数据时，从当前显示位置继续过渡。
